(ta)༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang lugs dang rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs dang gtor chog dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so/ /ser chen lha dgu/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang lugs dang rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs dang gtor chog dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so// ser chen lha dgu// ༄༅// na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dang*// rin chen mang sprul la btud nas// de nyid mnyes par byed pa'i thabs// mkhas pa'i gsung bzhin bshad kyis nyon// rten gyi gang zag dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ phyag na rdo rje dang chos skyong chen po'i rjes gnang thob pa/ khyad par gyi dam tshig stod g.yogs sngon po bgo ba/ lung thang gi phreng ba bgrang ba/ rta'i sha mi za ba/ yug sa mos phyag tshang byas pa'i zas mi za ba/ re ba nag po'i stan la mi 'dug pa/ snod kha chag tu zas mi za ba/ mi ro rta ro la mi 'ju ba ste/ dam tshig bdun dang ldan pa/ phyi rten rta sngon po dngos sam gzugs/ nang rten cho ga dang mthun par byas pa'i bris sku/ gsang rten bshad pa ltar byas pa'i bai yig sngags dang bcas pa'i ga'u ste/ rten gsum tshang bar btsugs shing 'di bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas yar ngo'i gza' skar bzang po la gtsang zhing dben pa'i gnas su/ yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku dgram/ maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa la gtso 'khor dgu'i tshom bu dgod/ yi dam chos skyong rta bdag brgyad/ 'khor spyi rnams la che zhing bzang ba'i gtor ma re re'am/ ma 'byor na yi dam chos skyong la re re/ skong bshags byed na khang bzang gi dbyibs su byas pa'i skong gtor che ba gcig chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang spyan gzigs dang rol mo'i bye brag la sogs pa ci 'byor pa dang*/ rmig zlum dang mdzo tol gyi sha dang chang ma gtogs pa'i tshogs rdzas ci 'byor pa bshams la/ yo byad rnams la dri bzang gi chu gtor te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i gsang gtor/

mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ ces dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñca ma naṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas shab+da'i mthar rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ shū n+ya tās sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing*/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can nas dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drang*/

gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la thim par bsam/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drang*/ gong ltar mchod/ de rnams kyis oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ nī laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lung thang gi phreng ba la ci nus bgrang*/ mthar/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi sngon du 'gro ba'i oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje ni// lcang lo can gyi pho brang na// gdug pa can rnams 'dul mdzad pa// gos sngon can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma sngar ltar bsang sbyang*/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du kham̐ las byung ba'i zhal zas dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ma dag pa bsang*/ a kā ro sogs kyis bdud rtsir byas/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru sogs dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis sngags kyis rgya cher spel la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gong bzhin phyag na rdo rje yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ nī laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ādz+nyā pa ya ti/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo ghā ya swā hā/ zhes gsum mam lnga la sogs pas dbul/

gong ltar mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon can// klu chen brgyad kyis sku la brgyan// zhe sdang can rnams 'dul ba'i rtags// nyon mongs spangs la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag na rdo rje stobs po che// rdo rje lan gsum gsor bas ni// gnod sbyin drag po 'dul mdzad pa// gnod sbyin gos sngon phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni// ri rgyal lhun po'i byang phyogs na// rgyal po btul nas nor sgrub mdzad// gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni// me ri 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs// rnam rgyal khro bo'i skur bstan nas// khro bo'i ngar skad drag po yis// thams cad kun 'dul phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni// mkha' lding rgyal por skur sprul nas// klu rgyal thabs kyis 'dul mdzad pa'i// rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan rdo rje gos sngon ni// dur khrod chen po'i gnas dag tu// nag po chen por skur sprul nas// ru dra 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa rdzogs pa'am gang rigs kyi mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la// tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel// sku gsum lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// ces brjod/ de nas rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis/ 'khyil pa'i sngags dang dri bzang gi chus phyogs kun tu bsang gtor byas la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par bsam/ de la sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ 'khyil pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ oṃ bai shra wa na sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha oṃ āḥhūm̐/

de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñca ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da rnams spel la mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan// gser ri lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing*// sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi ldan pa// 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' khyab yid 'ong lha rdzas dngos kun dang*// bka' 'bangs bran slad rang lus nyer bdog bcas// ma chags mi zhum zab cing rgya che'i phyir// dgongs chen bsgrub phyir dge tshogs rgya mtshos mchod// rang gi rgyu sngon ma bsags 'bras 'dod dang*// don med don log cung zad don phyir ni// ha cang 'dod chen bskyed dang chog ma shes// bsam sbyor nongs pa gang mchis mthol lo bshags// lha klu mi rnams 'jigs dang phongs pa las// myur skyob 'jig rten skyong rgyal 'jig rten las// kun sgrol kun nas phan dang bde ster ba// phrin las rgyun mi chad la rjes yi rang*// sna tshogs yang dag 'jigs dang mgon med dang*// bde sdug brel phongs brgyas gzir skal ngan rnams// dbugs dbyung slad du thugs gsung sku dang 'od// nyi zla rgyal mtshan ne'u le rnam rol bskul// khyod sku khro dang 'dzum dang brjid mdzes 'gying*// sgeg dul brtan 'jigs dpa' bo'i gar dgu yis// mi srun tshar gcod skal ldan rjes bzung phyir// bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'dar bdag gsol 'debs// de ltar 'gro skyob khyod la 'gro bde'i slad// lha mchog lhag pa'i lhar bzung bsnyen bkur bas// bdag sogs mgon med mgon mdzod rtag tu yang*// shes rab thugs rjes mi bsnyel mi gtong shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ bdag gi gnas gsum gyi oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum du phog pas thams cad 'od du zhu nas stong nyid 'od gsal ba spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar gyur par bsams pa ni sngon 'gro'i tshogs bsags pa'o// dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa ni/

stong pa'i ngang las mdun du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs dang bcas pa/ 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i dbus su khang pa brtsegs ma dgu yod pa/ dbus ma'i pho brang gsum brtsegs su gnas pa'i rtse mo rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ logs rnams su drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing*/ mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ shar shel/ lhor bai ḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'i ka ba nyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgya phyogs re rer brgyan pa/ gter gyi khang pa bco lnga bco lngas spras pa/ phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du bum pa bzang po brgyad/ dpag bsam gyi shing brgyad/ rin po che'i ljon shing brgyad/ rdzing bu bzang po ljon shing dang me tog gis brgyan pa brgyad/ 'dod 'jo'i ba brgyad rnams spel mar gnas pa/ phyi nas rin po che'i rwa ba gru bzhi pas bskor ba/ pho brang dbus ma'i nang du hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bai yig gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te bai yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po ngal bsos po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas dgos 'dod thams cad stsol ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhal nas rin po che'i char 'bebs shing*/ skye dgu thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal las sgrol ba/ dbu la rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol zhing*/ sku la rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/

phrag gong g.yas g.yon gnyis la nyi ma dang zla bas brgyan pa/ seng ge dkar po nyal thabs su gnas te de nyid la gdong lta ba'i steng na sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes shing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa'o// phyogs mtshams kyi khang brtsegs rnams su pad+ma'i gdan re re'i steng du/ shar du rmugs 'dzin ser po rin po che/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po rin po che'i bum pa/ nub tu nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu/ byang du ku be ra nag po ral gri/ shar lhor yang dag shes ser po gser gri/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po rin po che'i mdung*/ nub byang du lngas rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs/ byang shar du 'jam po la 'khyil pa dkar po gri phub 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan dang*/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ rang rang gi mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rta la chibs pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid la mi sdug pa'i cha byad can no// 'khor sa bar pa la gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs rnams dang*/ 'khor sa tha ma la sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa lha ma srin sde brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i tshogs mi sdug cing brjid la rngams pa/ phyag g.yas na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin cing*/ g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ sku mdog mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsams la/ man ngag las 'byung ba'i spos sam/ med na 'bras phye dang spos dkar bsres pa sreg cing rol mo sna tshogs dang bcas te/ rang phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi sna la 'dod rgyal dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa spros pas des byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te mdun du bskyed pa'i rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la gnyis su med par thim par yang yang bsam zhing*/

rgyal po 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya'am/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bya/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying bas// mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing*// gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod// thugs dam zhal bzhes de dgongs la// 'dren pa'i bstan pa srung ba dang*// sems can kun la phan slad du// byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams// sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bai swā hā/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes brjod/ bai ring po brjid dang ldan pa mig 'dzum sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi yun tsam brjod pas rgyal po'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab ma re re la bai bzhi bzhi bsam zhing*/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa'i thugs kar 'od zer gyi lcags kyus dbyer med du byas par bsam/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣañcā mi/ zhes pas rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po sogs gong ltar bsam/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la sngar ltar byin gyis brlab/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i bsang gtor 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol// 'khyil pa'i sngags dang*/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsha oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas bsang gtor dang*/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar du 'don pa bsgyur bas nyer spyod 'bul/ spro na/ rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang*// gter chen bum pa pad+ma bzang*// dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpa' be'u dang*// mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs// dngos grub rnam gnyis stsal ba'i phyir// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ bai shra wa na sa pa ri wā ra aṣ+ṭa maṅga la pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/

zhes pas bkra shis rdzas brgyad dbul/ phun tshogs 'khor lo rin po che// dri med btsun mo khyim bdag dang*// cang shes rta dang theg chen glang*// phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i// dmag dpon rin chen sna bdun rnams// bdag gi bsam pa yongs rdzogs phyir// rgyal chen sras dang btsun mor bcas// 'khor dang bcas pas bzhes su gsol// mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ sap+ta rat+na pū dza me gha sogs kyis rin chen sna bdun dbul/ yid 'ong gzugs mdzes rnam pa dang*// rnar snyan rol mo'i rnam pa dang*// yid 'dzin dri dang phun tshogs kyi// ro mchog brgyad ldan zhal zas dang*// 'jam mnyen 'khril chags na bza' ste// 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam lnga'i tshogs// rab 'byams zhing na gang yod rnams// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ pañca kā ma gu ṇa pū dza sogs kyis 'dod yon dbul/ bsdus pa la dga' na/ de rnams kyi tshigs bcad dor te sngags tsam gyis dbul/ spro na yan lag bdun pa sngar bzhin bya gsungs kyang*/ tshogs bsags sngon du song ba'i tshe ma grub kyang nyes pa med do// de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na// bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni// ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che// sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la bstod// btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang*// khyad par las sgrub gnod sbyin brgyad// nor ster ba yi klu chen brgyad// lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// dgra bgegs ma lus gzhom pa dang*// 'byor pa'i longs spyod phun tshogs shing*// 'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// gzhan don lhun gyis grub par mdzod// ces bstod/ rgyal po'i thugs ka'i pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje ser po'i lte bar bai yig gser gyi mdog can/ snying po dang gzungs kyi phreng bas bskor ba dang*/

'khor rnams kyi thugs kar yang zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa'i mthar so so'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam/ rang gi lce rdo rje'i sbu gur bsams la/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe thugs ka'i sa bon dang sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse las mchod pa sna tshogs spros te rgyal po 'khor bcas mchod pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po spros te 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal 'byor gzi brjid/ longs spyod la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas bdag gi snying gar bstim par bsam zhing*/ phyag na rdo rje'i sngags ci rigs zhig sngon du bzlas la/ de nas rgyal po'i sngags bzla'o// gzungs ni/ tad+ya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ tsi li tsi li ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e h+ye hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba ar+tha me sā dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ su dha ni/ su ra ṇi/ su ma ti/ su pu ṣe/ hi li mi li swā hā/ snying po ni/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya swā shā/ zhes pa ste bsnyen pa'i tshad ni bzhi 'bum mo// 'khor gyi sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha lā ya swā hā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ oṃ saṃ pradz+nyā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ gu has+thā nā ya swā hā/ oṃ pañci kā ya swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa lā ya swā hā/ zhes pa rnams gtso bo la ji tsam bzlas pa'i bcu cha re bzla'o// bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o// sgrub pa ni gzhan 'dra ba las/ bsnyen pa rdzogs nas maṇ+ḍal tsan+dan dkar pos byugs pa la tshom bu bkod de/ rgyal po 'khor bcas snga ma bzhin du bskyed la/

sngags bzla ba'i tshe a ga ru bsreg cing thun drug tu sgrub pa'o// de gnyis gang ltar yang thun 'jog pa'i tshe mchod bstod rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa byas la/ gtor ma mi 'bul na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bzod par gsol te gshegs gsol bya'o// gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ gong du bshams pa'i gtor ma rnams chu gtsang mas bran/ 'khyil pas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ kham̐ las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams rim pa bzhin du brtsegs pa de la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas yi ge gsum zhu nas nyes skyon thams cad dag par bsam/ ā ka ros bdud rtsir bsgyur/ ru ru s+phu ru dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis rgya chen por spel/ thun gsham yin na/ gtor mgron gong gi de nyid la dbul/ min na phyag rdor la yang sngar bshad pa'i cho gas 'dir phul la/ maṇ+ḍal 'khyil pas bsangs la/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs pa nas bzlas pa'i rjes kyi mchod bstod kyi bar gong bzhin byas la/ de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ 'khyil pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ bai shra wa na sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha swā hā/ zhes lnga'am bdun dang*/ rta bdag rnams la so so'i sngags kyi swā hā'i gong du i daṃ man chad bcug pa dbul/ 'khor gzhan rnams la/ oṃ aṣ+ṭa nā ga sha dhū ta sa ha sra ko ṭi yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa i daṃ zhes sogs kyis sam/ bsdu na a kā ros phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐/ rin chen pho brang dam pa na// mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na// bai las byung ba'i mgon pa ni// ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che// sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs// g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin// g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams// sku ni gser gyi 'od pas mdzes// zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs// thugs rjes phongs pa las sgrol mdzad// sku la rin chen rgyan gyi brgyan// byang phyogs rgyal por sku yang sprul// rnam thos sras zhes mtshan yang grags// gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dbu la rin chen cod pan gsol// yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// sde bo che la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed// stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo// bum pa bzang pos rnam par brgyan// dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// rdzing bu bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba// gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dzam+bha la ni gser gyi mdog

/rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon na ne'u le g.yas pa na// rin chen bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang ba bzang po sku mdog ser// rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon na ne'u le g.yas pa na// bum pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nor bu bzang po sku mdog dkar// rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon na ne'u le g.yas pa na// nor bu bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ku be ra ni sku mdog nag /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon na ne'u le g.yas pa na// ral gri bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag shes ni sku mdog ser// rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon na ne'u le g.yas pa na// gser gri bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'brog gnas sku mdog nag po la// rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon na ne'u le g.yas pa na// mdung dmar bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lngas rtsen sku mdog ser skya la// rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon na ne'u le g.yas pa na// khang brtsegs bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni dkar// rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs// g.yon na ne'u le g.yas pa na// gri phub bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyi 'khor// mdog mi sdug pa sna tshogs te// g.yon pa thams can ne'u le la// g.yas rnams mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed// gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis// khams gsum thams cad dbang du sdud// khyod ni gter bdag chen po ste// nor bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po rnam thos sras// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes nas kyang*// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la// bu sdug bzhin du skyong bar mdzad du gsol// bdag la gnod par sems pa yi// log par zhugs pa'i sems can rnams// de yi phru ma gzhom pa dang*// gtan nas brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che mnga' ba'i// gnod sbyin bdag po khyed rnams kyis// bdag gi bsam pa ma lus pa// myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes pas phrin las gzhol/

skong bshags byed na/ skong rdzas sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin brlab pa'am/ mi nus na gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa so so'i gtor sngags kyis gtso 'khor thams cad la bsngos la/ bstod chen gyi mchod 'bul gyi le'u dang*/ bshags pa'i le'u tsam byas nas rjes chog byas pas don 'grub bo// 'bring du byed na gong gi bstod pa dang phrin las gzhol ba bzhag la/ bstod chen gyi gnas bstod dang*/ gtso bo'i bstod pa rdzogs pa'am thugs la bstod pa yan tsam/ sras la bstod pa'i dbu nas sh+lo ka gnyis/ 'khor la bstod pa'i klu chen gyi bstod pa yan/ nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul dang*/ rgyud sde 'dzin pa'i sgo nas bstod pa rnams kyi dbu nas sh+lo ka re re/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam 'phrul du bstan pa tshang ma rnams byas nas skong bshags gong ltar byas pa'i mthar/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum gyi phrin las bskul ba yan tsam bya'o// rgyas par na bstod chen tshang ma skong bshags dang 'brel bar bya ba ste/ 'on kyang drag po'i phrin las kyi bskul ba ni rnal 'byor pa nus pa thob par drag po'i gtor ma dang 'brel ba'i tshe ma gtogs/ rang la chos skyong 'go ba'i ched du sgrub pa yin nam byas par legs pa mkhas pa rnams bzhed do// de nas tshogs rdzas

dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i/ yod na byin gyis brlabs la/ gtor ma ltar/ phud bla ma dang yi dam chos skyong la phul/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs dang*/ yi dam dang*/ chos skyong gi gtor sngags kyis phul/ bar pa dngos grub kyi bsam pas longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus te uts+tshiṣ+ṭa'i sngags kyis lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la bsngos la rol mo dang bcas pas phyir btang ngo*// gang ltar yang cho ga rdzogs nas rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bris sku yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ bai ring po mig 'dzum sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi tshad du brjod pas/ rgyal po'i thugs ka'i 'od kyi lcags kyu grol te pad 'dab kyi bai rnams gshegs par bsams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// byang phyogs gnas su gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// muḥ zhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyis se gol byas pas/ ye shes pa slar 'byon par bzhed bzhin pa'i sgo nas byang phyogs su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim par bsams la/ rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal du gnas pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod de/ dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis dang dga' ston rgya chen po bya'o// de ltar phyag na rdo rje dang*// rgyal chen rnam sras mnyes pa'i thabs// dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya 'di// sbyar ba'i dge bas sangs rgyas kyi// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu sku khams bzang*// 'jig rten bde zhing skyid pa sogs// srid zhi'i phun tshogs rgyas par shog /'di nyid dang por bskul ba dang*// bar du nyams len mdzad pa dang*// tha mar yi rang byed rnams kyang*// chos skyong chen pos skyong gyur cig

/rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos skyong chen po la dad cing mos pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen drang po lung mkhan chen kun dga' rdo rjes yun ring mo nas bskul ba'i ngor/ btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis kun mkhyen gnyis pa bu ston chos rje'i gsung rab rnams gung bsgrigs te lag len dang yig cha gzhan gyi spros pa thams cad btang snyoms su bzhag nas/ bsre bslad spangs te shin tu dag par lcags mo phag gi lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i yar tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin e wam̐ chos ldan gyi ri khrod du sbyar ba'o// 'di'i dge bas rgyal po chen po'i thugs dgos 'dod kyi 'byung gnas rin po che yongs su mnyes par gyur cig yi ge 'di la gzhan gyis bsre bslad ma byed cig gu h+ya sa ma ya sid+dhi// ༈ /swa sti/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras la mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ mgon po gnas srung 'khor bcas la// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul// sngags dang ting 'dzin las byung ba'i// kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos// mar me dri bzang zhal zas mchog /zag med bde skyed nyer spyod rnams// 'jig rten mtha' dag bkang nas 'bul// pi wang gling bu zangs dung dang*// dung dang rdza rnga rnga bo che// rol mo'i khyad par stong phrag bcu'i// snyan pa'i sgra yis rab tu mchod// dge ba'i stobs las 'khrungs pa yi// dpag bsam shing las byung gyur pa// lha rdzas yo byad ma lus rnams// blo yis blangs nas 'phul bar bgyi// mi dbang bsod nams mthu las byung*// 'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun/ rgyal po 'gran zla med byed pa'ang*// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// lha mi'i dpal ni 'phel byed cing*// don kun 'grub par byed pa'i rdzas// gdugs sogs bkra shis brgyad po yang*// gnas srung 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// gya nom phul byung 'jig rten khams// bkang nas gnas srung 'khor bcas kyi// dbang po lnga rnams tshims phyir 'bul// rang gri la sogs grub pa'i rdzas// mkha' spyod la sogs dngos grub star// grub pa nyi shu rtsa mdun yang*// rgyal chen thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir 'bul// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags mthu stobs dang*// chos dbyings rnam dag byin rlabs kyis// gtor ma 'di ni lha rdzas kyi// bdud rtsi la sogs longs spyod tshogs// zag med bde ba skyed nus pa// ngal bsos 'khor bcas spyan lam du// nam mkha' gang bar 'byung gyur cig

/khyed la bkres skom mi mnga' yang*// zag med bde ba rgyas pa'i rgyur// rnal 'byor bdag cag don slad du// dmigs med tshul gyis bzhes su gsol// lha min g.yul las rgyal byed pa'i// nor bu'i tog 'bar ba dan g.yo// rgyal mtshan 'di 'bul bdud dpung gi /dgra las rgyal bar mdzad du gsol// rin chen bdun las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*// bkod legs dbyibs mdzes sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras// lcang lo can mtshungs sprul pa'i khang brtsegs 'di// rgyal chen 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i gnas su 'bul// phyi nang dar zab bar du srin bal can// gong thod stod chod rab mdzes rin chen gyi// srad bus zungs btab sham dkris sub mas bskor// ber chen bzang 'di rgyal po'i na bzar 'bul// rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar sngo zhing mdzes// nyi zla lta bur mig 'bur mtho la rgyas// phrum phrum yid yong char sprin lta bus gtibs// na bun lta bu'i ze rngog rab gzhol zhing*// char chu'i rgyun ltar rnga ma'i rgyun ring la// bar snang lta bur rkang lag khong yangs shing*// glog phreng lta bur rmig bzhi rab 'khyugs pa// cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang lta bu'i rta// glang po'i dbang po lta bur nyams stobs ldan// mkha' lding lta bur rtsol med gom pa'i shugs// rtsol bas chung 'bring rab tu cher bgrod pa'i// 'gros gsar bgam dang bang gis myur du bgrod// mgyogs tshad 'gro ba mi mthong lta bur ldan// rta mchog rin chen lta bu 'di dag ni// dkar ser dmar dang mtshal lu zhur po dang*// ngang pa 'ol ba sna tshogs la sogs pa'i// rta mchog gser gyi g.yer khas mgrin pa spras// srab 'jam yang la mdzes pa'i sha stan dang*// a mo li ka'i thags la stan du gtad// rin chen shel la gser gyis spras pa'i sga// gser la dngul gyis bsdams pa'i sga glegs can// rin chen kar ke ta ni yob stan la// in+d+ra nī la'i yob chen mdzes pa can// pad+ma rā ga'i 'bring dmar mdzes pa la// rin chen mar gad rgyun gyis shar bus btab// gong thag smed chen smed chung rab sgeg cing*// bai ḍūr+ya yi glo thag mdzes pa ni// rdo rje pha lam pho long dam pos bsdams// rin chen bdun gyis kun nas spungs pa yi// srab 'go kha lo sgyur ba'i srab skyogs dang*// mu tig 'bur gyis bsdams pa'i pho long bcings// lha rdzas dar gyis byas pa'i thur mda' dang*// myur du skul byed shel gyi lcag 'bras can// rta mchog rgyan dang chas kyis spras 'di rnams// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// mgon po zhon pas phongs pa mi mnga' yang*// bdag sogs bstan 'dzin rnams kyi don slad bzhes// phyogs bcur phrin las sna tshogs bsgrub tu gsol// bsod nams stobs las grub pa'i 'dod 'jo'i ba// yid la ci bsam nu ma las 'byung ma// mdzes shing yid 'ong don kun 'grub pa 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// de bzhin yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// bum bzang ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog dang*// khrus rdzing sman ljongs skyed mos tshal la sogs// mchod rdzas yid 'ong thams cad 'bul bar bgyi// rmig bzhi rab brten rwa ni rno la ring*// rtsid pa'i zhol ring rnga ma kun la g.yo// dar gyi phud bus mdzes par brgyan pa yi// zhol chen g.yag 'di khyed la 'bul bar bgyi// dkar la 'jam pa'i spu yi gos gyon zhing*// 'khyil pa'i rwa la chu ris mdzes pas brgyan// gnas chen rnams kyi 'dod pa'i don bsgrub pa'i// lug gi khyu 'di khyed kyi 'brog tu 'bul// gangs ri ltar dkar bcu drug gling can rmog

/srab mdzes byang bu rin chen rgyan gyis spel// sra brtan sbabs dang ldan pa'i khrab 'di dang*// phub zhol spang leb bcas pa'i go 'di 'bul// rin chen rgyu las mkhas pas legs sbyangs shing*// rno ngar rtsal dang ldan pa'i ral gri 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// bstan pa'i dgra rnams gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol// gser dngul gos dang ja ras stag gzig dang*// snam bu sha mar ka ra bu ram sogs// spyan gzigs yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyang*// mgon po 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// mgon po khyod la phongs pa mi mnga' yang*// bdag sogs sems can rnams kyi don slad du// bzhes nas 'gro ba'i 'dod don sgrub pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad du gsol// bshags pa bya ba ni/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras dang*/ de'i sras dang btsun mor bcas pa dang*/ blon po chen po rta bdag brgyad dang sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*/ stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ ljongs chen dang*/ yul 'khor skyong ba'i gnod sbyin 'khor dang g.yog tu bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis nyan thos kyi theg pa'i sgor bzhugs te/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba ci bgyis pa thams cad nyan thos chen po khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa'i sgor bzhugs nas byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba thams cad byang chub sems dpa' chen po khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// sngags kyi theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas gsang sngags kyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// khyad par du'ang rgyal po chen po khyod la bka' sdod du gsol zhing skyabs su song nas khyed kyi bka' dang dam tshig las 'das te/

spyi'i dam tshig gsum ma bsrungs pa dang*/ khyad par gyi dam tshig bzhi dang 'gal ba bgyis pa dang*/ 'jig rten ngo srung gi dbang gis snod ma yin par chos bstan pa dang*/ khyad par rgyal po'i bka' lung sbyin par mi 'os pa la byin pa dang*/ rang 'dod kyi dbang gis phrin las zhu bar mi 'os pa la zhus pa dang*/ le lo'i dbang gis bzlas sgom chag pa dang*/ ser sna'i dbang gis mchod pa dang gtor ma chag cing ngan pa dang*/ dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dang 'grogs pa la sogs pa rgyal po chen po'i thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad mthol lo bshags so// dmigs med chos sku'i ngang du bzod par bzhes nas bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ spros pa mi mnga' chos sku'i ngang nyid las// bsnyen sring mi mnga' kun tu gsan pa'i snyan// sgrib pa mi mnga' thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs// bsnyel ba mi mnga' gsan cing dgongs su gsol// thog med dus nas nyon mongs las dbang gis// bag med stobs kyis nyes pa gang bgyis pa// skye med chos sku'i ngang du so sor bshags// sprin med nam mkha' lta bur dag gyur cig /khyad par khyed kyi dam tshig las 'das te// bag med 'chol pas thugs dam ma bskangs pa// bde chen longs sku'i ngang du so sor bshags// mkha' la na bun yal ba ltar gyur cig /dam tshig tshogs 'dres 'chol pa spyod dang 'grogs// dam nyams dri mas phog pa'i nyes pa rnams// cir snang sprul sku'i ngang du so sor bshags// bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin dag gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni kun mkhyen bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i bstod chen rgyal po'i thugs rab tu mnyes par byed pa las byung ba'o// shu bhaṃ// ༈ /phyag rdor 'gro bzang lugs dang rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sbags sgrub kyi rjes gnang bzhugs so// na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ dpal phyag na rdo rje dang rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sngags sgrub kyi rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas/

yar ngo'i dus tshes gza' skar bzang po la rten dang rten gtor khang pa brtsegs ma/ mchod gtor/ zlum gtor gnyis/ bsham pa dang*/ phyag rdor dang rgyal chen gyi mngon rtogs gtor 'bul bzlas pa dang bcas pa gtor chog ltar byas la/ dam tshig gtsang zhing bstan pa la gus pa'i slob ma khrus byas/ phyag dang rin po che'i yon phul/ me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed pa gsal btab/ de la 'dir slob dpon chen po 'gro bzang snying po'i zhal snga nas/ rang dang gzhan gyi don la mngon par brtson pas rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad pa la brten nas dpal phyag na rdo rje'i zhal gzigs shing*/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa des/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyi dbul ba bsal ba dang*/ bstan pa la gnod pa'i gdug pa can rnams tshar gcad pa'i phyir/ rgyud rdo rje sa 'og dang*/ gar mkhan mchog dang*/ sna tshogs grub pa rnams la brten nas dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dang*/ rnam thos sras kyi zhi ba nor sgrub dang*/ drag byed kyi cho ga la sogs pa mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rgyal po chen po sbags sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bya bar 'os pa dpal phyag na rdo rje'i bdag mdun sgrub cing gtor ma dbul ba dang*/ rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed cing spyan drang ba/ mchod cing gtor ma 'bul ba/ thugs rgyud bzlas pas bskul ba rnams dgos pa sngon du grub par byas nas/ khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa maṇ+ḍal dbul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba rnams dgos pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la dpal phyag na rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// brtse chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyis// ma lus rjes gnang bka' drin stsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/

rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ 'og gi cha la rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar rang dang gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas thal mo sbyar te/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas nas/ slob dpon gyis shū n+ya tā'i sngags brjod pas slob ma'i phung khams dang skyed mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes hūm̐ yig sngon po zhes sogs nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar dal bur brjod pas slob ma lhar bskyed/ de ltar khyed rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal du gnas pa'i mdun du bh+rūm̐ las zhes sogs nas/ sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin du bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gyis rgyal po 'khor bcas bskyed/ slob dpon phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dang 'dod rgyal spros nas ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi rgyal po 'khor bcas la thim par bsam pa'i dmigs pa gong ltar phog la spos bsreg spyan 'dren gyi sngags rnams yang yang brjod cing rol mo bya/ bai ring brjod cing dam ye'i thugs 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sbrel bar bsam/ cod pan gyis dbang skur gnas gsum byin rlabs byas la/ de la slob mas byas par bsams nas/ slob dpon gyis mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs shig bya ste/ de rnams lha bsgom pa'i rjes gnang yin/ slob dpon phyag rdor du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung ste slob ma'i snying gar hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod par bsams la/

phyag rdor gyi sngags lan gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te gtso 'khor so so'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bu byung*/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi phun tshogs dang dngos grub thams cad 'od zer gyi sne mo la bsdus te/ khyed rang rnams la thim zhing sngags phreng zhal du zhugs te thugs kar thim par mos pa dang bcas pas slob mas slob dpon gyi phreng ba'i sne mo nas bzung ste gzungs ring tshar gsum/ snying po brgya dang brgyad/ rta bdag gi sngags lan bdun bdun/ thugs ka'i bai yig las de 'dra ba rang la 'phos par bsams la bai yig mig 'dzum so gnyis yun rnams rjes zlos bya/ phreng ba dang me tog slob dpon la phul te/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis kyang de rnams sngags su byas te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod de sngags bzlas pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyis rgyal po la mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la gtor ma slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag te/ gzungs dang snying po tshar gcig brjod pa'i mthar/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ 'gro bzang snying po/ rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ g.yor po jo ston/ bla ma bsod nams rin chen/ 'byi phu pa pad+ma bkra shis/ rtag pa jo bzang*/

'di lha rje mgo bcos pa la shin tu mkhas zer/ khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug rin chen bsod nams seng ge/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ kun mkhyen bu ston chos rje/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig las ma 'da' bar/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ gnod sbyin rta bdag brgyad/ sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di'i bka' sdod dang chos skyong ba'i srung ma mdzad nas dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'bral ba med par 'grogs nas bar du gcod pa thams cad las bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba bar mdzad du gsol/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub pa dang*/ lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba mang po dbang du 'dus nas zas gos longs spyod thams cad thogs pa med pa yid bzhin du 'byor pa dang*/ de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phrin las dang stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod pas rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis kyang ji ltar bsgos pa bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes te khyed rang gi phyi bzhin du 'brang bar mos pa mdzod/ de bka' bsrung gtad pa'i rjes gnang yin/ de nas rnam sras kyi 'khor du gtogs pa'i gnod sbyin dang srin po gdug pa can mang po yod pa rnams kyis sgrub pa po la 'tshe ru 'ong bas/

de rnams tshar gcad pa'i phyir drag po'i rjes gnang ni/ slob ma phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang rnam pa gsal bar bskyed cing de'i bzhugs stangs byar gzhug lag pa g.yas su gri'am rdo rje gtad/ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub snying gar bzhag zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas gdug pa can gyi dpon po'i snying gar mnan nas gzir bar bsams la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spro ba lnga bya ste/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das su gsal ba'i phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje las rdo rje thog lta bu phyogs bcur spros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ thugs ka nas khro chung gi tshogs spros/ ma rungs pa thams cad bya sgro rlung gis gtor ba bzhin rgyang ring du gtor/ ba spu'i bu ga nas ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba spros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bkang ste gdug pa can thams cad mes bsregs/ sku'i rgyan gyi klu chen brgyad las gdug pa'i kha rlangs 'phros/ ma rungs pa thams cad myos shing brgyal bar byas/ gsung gi rig sngags kyi nga ro 'brug gi sgra lta bu bsgrags pas gdug pa can thams cad btul zhing spa bkong bar byas par mos/ de nas rgyal po'i spro ba gsum bya ste/ rgyal po'i sku stod las bya dang gcan gzan gyi tshogs spros/ sa bla'i gdug pa can thams cad btul/ sked pa nas gnod sbyin dang srin po'i tshogs spros/ sa steng gi gdug pa can thams cad btul/ sku smad las stag dang sbrul la sogs pa spros/ sa 'og gi gdug pa can thams cad btul bar bsams la/ dpon slob gnyis kas hūm̐ bai shra ba ṇā ya a nu tsa ra ku ru hūm̐/ zhes bzla zhing lan gsum tsam song ba na gu gul gyi dud pa dang rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas te ci rigs bzla/ mthar zhabs kyi 'og na gnas pa de bton te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus gsol/ me tog la sogs pa lngas mchod pas/ des kyang bka' bzhin du bsgrub par bgyi'o// zhes khas blangs par mos pa bya/

slob dpon gyis dam tshig bsrung dgos rnams ngo sprad/ slob mas de rnams la bsrung bsdom bgyi snyam pas gtso bos ji ltar sogs brjod cing khas blangs/ gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus dang longs spyod kyang 'bul snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ tshogs sam dga' ston la longs spyad/ slob dpon gyis rjes chog bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam sogs bya'o// rnam thos sras kyi rjes gnang gi cho ga 'di'ang*/ kun mkhyen bu ston chos rje'i gsung rab las btus te/ ngag 'don bde bar btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis lcags mo phag gi lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i yar tshes bco lnga'i nyin e wam̐ chos ldan du sbyar ba'o// 'di la nyes pa'i cha mchis na// rgyal chen rnam thos sras la bshags// legs pa'i dge bas sangs rgyas kyi// bstan pa yun ring gnas gyur cig /snod min la gsang zhing sba bar bya ba'i chos yin no// gu h+ya sa ma ya sid+dhi// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
